own_scenes.desc: Tom Silverman, editor de la revista Dance Music Report, fundó Tommy Boy con un préstamo de sus padres y fichó a Bambaataa: «Jazzy Sensation», con los Jazzy Five sobre el «Funky Sensation» de Gwen McCrae, se alejaba del rumbo de Sugar Hill y le permitió contratar a Monica Lynch. Con «Planet Rock» llegaron pedidos de todo el país; asociada a Warner, Tommy Boy ficharía a Stetsasonic, Queen Latifah, De La Soul, Digital Underground o Coolio.

influences.name: Afrika Bambaataa y la Zulu Nation

refs.q: It was the first huge hit at Tommy Boy, and all of a sudden we were getting calls from all over the country for orders of this record in markets where we had never had distribution.
refs.para: Monica Lynch (A&R, Tommy Boy Records): It was the first huge hit at Tommy Boy, and all of a sudden we were getting calls from all over the country for orders of this record in markets where we had never had distribution. It really exploded.
